patientRequestRecorded.en: Your request has been recorded for processing.
patientRequestRecorded.translation: An rubuta buƙatarka domin a bi ta.

patientAwaitingReview.en: Your information has been saved for review by the care team.
patientAwaitingReview.translation: An adana bayananka domin ƙungiyar kulawa ta duba.

patientNoCallSummary.en: No clinical summary has been recorded for this call.
patientNoCallSummary.translation: Ba a rubuta taƙaitaccen bayanin lafiya na wannan kira ba.

welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Amsa wasu tambayoyi game da alamomin rashin lafiyarka. Likitanka zai duba komai kafin ku haɗu.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Wannan yana haɗa ziyararka da bayanan lafiyarka.

interviewAsking.translation: Ana tambaya game da alamomin rashin lafiyarka

interviewLoadError.translation: Ba mu iya buɗe tambayoyinka ba.

interviewComplete.en: Thanks, {name}. I have what I need. Let's review your answers before sending them to the doctor.
interviewComplete.translation: Na gode, {name}. Na samu abin da nake buƙata. Mu duba amsoshinka kafin aika su ga likita.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Na gode — zan yi wasu gajerun tambayoyi game da {complaint}. Yaushe ya fara?

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Na gode — zan yi wasu gajerun tambayoyi game da abin da ya kawo ka. Yaushe ya fara?

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Rubuta amsa, ko taɓa shawara a sama

severityWorst.translation: Mafi tsanani da aka taɓa ji

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Taɓa kowane bayani don gyara shi kafin aikawa.

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Ya yi daidai — aika ga likita

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Idan alamomin rashin lafiyarka sun yi tsanani ko suna ƙaruwa yanzu, kada ka jira — kira agajin gaggawa.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Don Allah nemi kulawa cikin awa 1–2

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Alamominka suna nuna cewa kana buƙatar a duba ka da wuri. Mun nuna wa ƙungiyar kulawa cewa lamarinka na gaggawa ne.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Ƙungiyar kulawa za ta karɓi tarihin lafiyarka nan take.

urgencyStep2Desc.en: Based on {level} urgency. You will be notified when a clinician opens it.
urgencyStep2Desc.translation: Bisa matakin gaggawa {level}. Za a sanar da kai idan ma'aikacin lafiya ya buɗe shi.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Idan ya ƙara tsanani, ɗauki mataki da sauri

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Idan ya yi tsanani ko ya ƙaru ba zato ba tsammani — kira agajin gaggawa nan take.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Wannan ƙiyasin gaggawa ne na na'ura, ba ganewar cuta ba. Ma'aikacin lafiya ne zai yanke hukunci na ƙarshe.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: An taɓa duba ka a wannan asibitin. Aika taƙaitaccen bayaninka kai tsaye can?

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Suna da bayananka, don haka ƙungiyar kulawarka za ta ga cikakken tarihinka nan take.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?
findSearchTitle.translation: A ina kake son a duba ka?

findSearchSubtitle.en: Pick a Triavi hospital near you — your {level} brief is sent the moment you choose.
findSearchSubtitle.translation: Zaɓi asibitin Triavi kusa da kai — za a aika bayaninka na mataki {level} da zarar ka zaɓa.

findScanning.translation: Ana neman asibitocin Triavi kusa da kai…

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: Ba mu iya samun wurin da kake ba. Taɓa sake nema don gwadawa.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Taƙaitaccen bayaninka yana wurin ƙungiyar kulawa. Za mu sanar da kai da zarar ma'aikacin lafiya ya buɗe shi.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Idan yana ƙara tsanani, ɗauki mataki yanzu

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Kada ka jira lokacinka a jerin jira. Idan alamominka sun yi tsanani ko sun ƙaru ba zato ba tsammani — kira agajin gaggawa yanzu ko je sashen gaggawa mafi kusa.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Mun ɗaga fifikon lamarinka domin ƙungiyar kulawa ta sani.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Ma'aikacin lafiya yana duba bayaninka. Za mu sanar da kai ci gaba.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Amsa wasu tambayoyi game da yadda kake tun bayan ziyararka.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Yaya yanayinka idan an kwatanta da da?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Akwai wani abu da kake son gaya mana?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Muna farin ciki da ka ji sauƙi

checkinResultResolvedBody.en: We'll check in again {next} to make sure you're still improving.
checkinResultResolvedBody.translation: Za mu sake duba ka {next} don tabbatar kana samun sauƙi.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today
checkinResultReview.translation: Ma'aikacin lafiya zai duba wannan yau

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: An aika amsoshinka ga ƙungiyar kulawa. Ma'aikacin lafiya zai duba su kuma ya tuntube ka idan ya zama dole.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Alamominka suna nuna kana buƙatar kulawa da sauri. Kada ka jira — tuntuɓi ƙungiyar kulawarka ko je sashen gaggawa mafi kusa.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Wannan bibiyar ba ta samuwa yanzu. Shiga don ganin rajistocinka na yanzu.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: An tabbatar da rajistarka. Ƙirƙiri asusu kyauta don bibiyar wannan ziyara kuma ka tsallake lamba nan gaba.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Za mu aika lambar amfani sau ɗaya — babu kalmar sirri da za ka tuna.

authSecuredBy.translation: Triavi na karewa · Ya bi ƙa'idodin HIPAA

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otpSentTo.translation: An aika zuwa {dest}. Wa'adinta zai ƙare cikin minti 10.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Shigar da lambar wayarka ko imel, za mu aika lambar shiga.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Asusunka yana haɗe da bayanan asibitinka

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Ba a iya aika lambar ba. Sake gwadawa.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Matsalar hanyar sadarwa. Duba haɗinka ka sake gwadawa.

errResendFailed.translation: Ba a iya sake aikawa ba. Sake gwadawa.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.
errCodeMismatch.translation: Lambar ba ta dace ba. Sake gwadawa.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Don tsaronka da kare bayanan marasa lafiya, an fitar da kai bayan ka daɗe ba ka amfani da manhajar.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Kiran kulawa yana shigowa cikin wannan manhajar · ba a taɓa raba lambar wayarka.

dashSimulateCall.translation: Gwada kiran kulawa mai shigowa · gwaji

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Zaɓi wanda zai kira ka da yadda muryarsa za ta kasance.

toneWarmDesc.translation: Mai kwantar da hankali, ba tare da gaggawa ba

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Kai tsaye, daidai, ba hira ta gefe ba

toneUpbeatDesc.translation: Mai sada zumunci da ƙarfafa gwiwa

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Sannu Jordan, lokacin maganinka na yamma ya yi…

medReminderCallsDesc.translation: Kira a kowane lokacin shan magani

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Babu kira 9:30 na dare – 7:30 na safe · za a aika sanarwa

comingSoon.translation: Yana zuwa nan ba da daɗewa ba

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Layin kulawarka yana aiki — sake shiga don sarrafa kira da tunatarwa.

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Kiran murya mai ɓoyayyen tsaro · WebRTC · ba a raba lambarka

callSummaryNoContact.translation: AN RUBUTA CEWA BA A AMSA BA

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Kai da {hospital} kaɗai za ku ga waɗannan. Taɓa ziyara don karanta taƙaitaccen bayanin da aka raba da kai.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Babu kiran kulawa na wannan ziyara tukuna.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Wannan taƙaitaccen bayanin da aka raba da kai ne — ba ganewar cuta ba. Idan alamominka sun dawo ko sun ƙara tsanani, nemi agajin gaggawa nan take.

visitDetailNotFound.translation: Ba mu sami wannan ziyara ba

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Wataƙila an cire ziyarar ko mahaɗin bai inganta ba. Koma baya don ganin cikakken tarihinka.

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Sabunta bayananka. Likitanka zai ga na baya-bayan nan.

labelEmergencyContact.translation: Wanda za a tuntuba a gaggawa

placeholderEmergencyName.translation: Sunan wanda za a tuntuba a gaggawa

placeholderEmergencyPhone.translation: Lambar wayar wanda za a tuntuba

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Yana canja harshen kowane shafi nan take.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Ba a iya kwafawa ba — zaɓa ka kwafa da kanka

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Abin da muke karewa da abin da kake sarrafawa.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Ana cire sunanka, bayanan tuntuɓa da amsoshin da ka rubuta kafin komai ya fita daga asibitinka. Ƙungiyar kulawarka kaɗai ke ganin bayanan da ke gane ka; bincike da nazari suna ganin bayanan da aka cire shaidarka kawai.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Ba da izinin amfani da bayanan da ba su nuna shaidarka ba don inganta kulawar kowa. Za ka iya canja wannan kowane lokaci.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Tunatarwar alƙawari da rajistar bibiya ta kira ko sanarwa. Za ka iya canja wannan kowane lokaci.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Cire asusunka da bayanan tuntuɓa har abada. Asibitinka zai riƙe tarihin layin kulawarka kamar yadda doka ta buƙata.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Nemi kwafin taƙaitattun ziyarorinka, magunguna da tarihin kiran kulawa.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Wannan zai cire asusunka da bayanan tuntuɓa har abada. Asibitinka zai riƙe tarihin layin kulawarka kamar yadda doka ta buƙata. Ba za a iya dawo da shi ba.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Ƙungiyar kulawarka za ta tabbatar ta imel cikin awa 72. Layin kulawarka zai ci gaba da aiki har zuwa lokacin.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Zaɓi tsari ka nemi fitar da bayananka. Za mu shirya su mu aika amintaccen mahaɗi zuwa imel ɗin da ka yi rajista da shi.

downloadSheetFormatPdf.translation: PDF (yana zuwa nan ba da daɗewa ba)

downloadRequestSubmitted.translation: An aika buƙatar fitar da bayanai

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Za mu aika amintaccen mahaɗi zuwa imel ɗin da ka yi rajista da shi cikin awa 24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Ba a sauke fayil a nan — ana aika bayananka cikin tsaro zuwa imel ɗin da ka yi rajista da shi.

callSummaryNoAnswerHospital.translation: An rubuta ba a amsa ba · {hospital}

callSummaryNoAnswerPlain.translation: An rubuta ba a amsa ba

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact
callSummaryDeclinedLogged.translation: An ƙi kira · an rubuta ba a samu tuntuɓa ba

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact
callSummaryEndedLogged.translation: Kira ya ƙare · an rubuta ba a samu tuntuɓa ba

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Manna mahaɗin gayyatar da asibitinka ya aika, ko duba lambar QR ɗinsu da kyamara.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Wannan bai yi kama da mahaɗin gayyata ko lambar Triavi ba.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteEnterManually.translation: Shigar da mahaɗin gayyata da hannu

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Ingantacciyar lambar asibiti za ta kai ka kai tsaye ga bayananka.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Ingantacciyar lambar asibiti za ta kai ka ga bayananka. Gwaji: taɓa gwajin lambar da aka gano don gwada hanyar.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Ba da izinin kyamara a saitunan burauzarka, ko shigar da mahaɗin gayyata da hannu.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Ba a gano kyamara ba. Shigar da mahaɗin gayyatar da asibitinka ya aika.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Kyamara ba ta samuwa yanzu. Shigar da mahaɗin gayyata da hannu.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Babu intanet · ana nuna tambayoyin da aka adana

questionOnset.translation: Yaushe alamomin rashin lafiyarka suka fara?

questionContext.en: Were you resting or active when it began?
questionContext.translation: Kana hutawa ko kana aiki lokacin da ya fara?

questionSeverity.en: How strong is the discomfort right now?

questionRadiation.translation: Shin ciwon yana yaduwa zuwa wani wuri?

questionAssociated.en: Are you noticing any of these as well?
questionAssociated.translation: Kana lura da ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan ma?

followupPain.en: How is your pain compared to when you were discharged?
followupPain.translation: Yaya ciwonka idan an kwatanta da lokacin sallama daga asibiti?

followupMeds.en: Have you been taking your medications as prescribed?
followupMeds.translation: Kana shan magungunanka kamar yadda aka rubuta?

followupFever.en: Do you still have a fever?

followupEating.en: Are you able to eat and drink normally?
followupEating.translation: Kana iya ci da sha kamar yadda aka saba?

choiceMildEffort.translation: Mai sauƙi — lokacin motsa jiki kawai

choiceNormalBreath.translation: Eh, ina numfashi yadda aka saba

choiceLessFood.translation: Ina cin abinci ƙasa da yadda aka saba

questionLocation.en: Where do you feel the symptoms?

questionModifiers.en: What makes the symptoms better or worse?
questionModifiers.translation: Me ke sa alamomin su ragu ko su ƙaru?

questionReady.en: Your answers are ready for review.

errRequest.en: We could not complete your request. Please try again.
errRequest.translation: Ba mu iya kammala buƙatarka ba. Don Allah sake gwadawa.

demoOnset.translation: Kusan awa 1–3 da suka wuce, lokacin hutawa

questionDuration.en: How long have you had this?

questionCharacter.en: How would you describe the quality of the discomfort?
questionCharacter.translation: Yaya za ka bayyana irin ciwon?

questionAggravating.translation: Me ke sa ya ƙara tsanani?

questionPrior.translation: Ka taɓa samun wannan a baya?

questionMedications.en: What medications are you currently taking?

questionAllergies.translation: Kana da wata rashin jituwa da wani abu ko magani?

questionHistory.en: Any relevant medical history I should know about?
questionHistory.translation: Akwai tarihin lafiya mai muhimmanci da ya kamata in sani?

questionRedFlags.en: Are you experiencing any severe or alarming symptoms?
questionRedFlags.translation: Kana da wasu alamomi masu tsanani ko masu tayar da hankali?

questionSeverityScale.en: How strong is the discomfort right now, from 0 to 10?
questionSeverityScale.translation: Yaya tsananin ciwon yanzu daga 0 zuwa 10?

callSharedTeam.translation: An raba da ƙungiyar kulawa ta {hospital}

callBackHour.en: We'll call you back in 1 hour · {hospital}
callBackHour.translation: Za mu sake kira cikin awa 1 · {hospital}

demoCallEvening.en: I'm calling to remind you about your evening dose of {med}.
demoCallEvening.translation: Ina kira don tunatar da kai game da maganinka na yamma, {med}.

demoCallDue.en: It's 8 o'clock — time for your {med}. Have you taken it yet?
demoCallDue.translation: Ƙarfe 8 ya yi — lokacin {med} ya yi. Ka sha shi?
